newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 477.25/478.25/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 477.25/478.25/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 477.25/478.25 per dollar on light Central Bank dollar sales, traders said.
"There was some demand for dollars at the end of the session, which weakened the exchange rate, but then the Central Bank came in and pushed the rate back down," said one trader.
Traders said continuing stability in the exchange rate had narrowed the spread between bid and ask prices, but the rate was not seen depreciating any more rapidly in coming days.
The strong bolivar is the government's central weapon in its fight against inflation.
